description:
intent=i023 snapshot=s02 branch=header-accessor-no-linearize status=complete
finding location=net/ncsi/ncsi-rsp.c:966-1031 confidence=medium conclusion=NCSI receive handler ncsi_rcv_rsp() dereferences skb_network_header() pointers (hdr->type/id/length and, in ncsi_validate_rsp_pkt(), attacker-length-driven checksum reads) with no pskb_may_pull or headlen guard anywhere in net/ncsi, so a non-linear ETH_P_NCSI frame causes linear-area OOB reads.
unresolved location=net/ieee802154/6lowpan/rx.c:80 conclusion=Follow up: trace ieee802154 RX into lowpan_process_data/lowpan_invoke_rx_handlers to determine whether a zero-linear-length skb can reach the *skb_network_header(skb) dispatch reads at rx.c:80-81 and 107.
unresolved location=net/xfrm/xfrm_input.c:205 conclusion=Follow up: verify whether xfrm4_rcv/xfrm6_rcv linearize the IP+SPI header bytes before the skb_transport_header()-derived SPI/seq reads at xfrm_input.c:147-158 and the daddr read at 205.
coverage_gap=Only net/ and drivers/net/ .c files were grepped for the seven accessor names; drivers/net was ranked but not per-function audited after the receive-path filter, so unguarded dereferences in NIC rx handlers (i40e/fm10k/ixgbe/sunvnet tx-named files aside) may remain unreviewed.
coverage_gap=net/ncsi reachability was established structurally (dev_add_pack of ETH_P_NCSI, eth_type_trans sets network header with only ETH_HLEN pulled) but no NCSI-capable driver (e.g. ftgmac100) was traced to confirm a frag-backed skb can actually be delivered to ncsi_rcv_rsp in s02.
coverage_gap=No runtime KASAN build or crafted non-linear ETH_P_NCSI / 6lowpan / xfrm packet was produced; the NCSI finding is a source-reading hypothesis with no empirical confirmation of head reallocation or OOB read.
limitation=The NCSI finding's concrete failure mode is an out-of-bounds read of the linear head (bytes past skb_headlen) rather than the seed's use-after-free, because no pskb_may_pull ever runs to move the head; the branch treats both as the same missing-linear-guarantee invariant.
limitation=Triggering the NCSI path requires CONFIG_NET_NCSI, a registered NCSI netdev, and an attacker positioned to inject frames on the NC-SI management side channel (often BMC-internal rather than internet-facing), so remote reachability is narrower than the seed's phonet case.
limitation=The hdr->length==payload equality at ncsi-rsp.c:37 blocks table-driven lengths, but the GP handler's payload==-1 path takes payload from the attacker's hdr->length directly, making the equality tautological; whether payload can exceed the actual linear bytes (rather than the full skb->len) was reasoned from source, not measured.
limitation=All candidates were classified by source reading in a single session with a bounded candidate budget (12); no cross-snapshot comparison, git history, or network access was used, per assignment constraints.
